source_title: Jolly Nigger Bank (replica? American patent 1882) cast iron novelty money box mechanical penny piggy bank stereotypical black beggar racist cartoonish blackface caricature Norwegian 2 øre 1 krone coins (Holocaust exhibition HL-sentere
desc_src: Photo taken at the Norwegian Center for Holocaust and Minority Studies (Norwegian: HL-senteret ) in Oslo, showing items from the permanent exhibition on antisemitism , the Holocaust , etc.: Jolly Nigger Bank , a cast iron novelty money box/mechanical penny bank/toy bank/piggy bank, (replica of) American patent originally from 1882 or later, sculpted as a stereotypical black beggar/a racist, cartoonish, coon or blackface caricature with old Norwegian 2 øre- and 1 krone-coins in hand. A similar historical money bank or collecting box is the Nickneger in German churches etc.
